name: Update Sensor Status
Restore status log baseline on deploy
Restore last status per device
func: msg.query='from(bucket:"communication_monitoring") |> range(start:1970-01-01T00:00:00Z) |> filter(fn:(r)=>r._measurement=="device_status_events" and r._field=="state_json" and r.source=="mqtt_status") |> group(columns:["device"]) |> last()';return msg;

name: Log device status CHANGES only
Retry same timestamp, up to 5 times
func: msg.statusLogRetries=Number(msg.statusLogRetries||0)+1;if(msg.statusLogRetries<=5){delete msg.error;return [msg,null];}return [null,{payload:{error:'Device status log write failed after retries; event not confirmed saved.'}}];

name: Safe status history error
func: return {payload:{error:msg.error?.source?.id==='rx_status_history_read'?'Cannot restore device status history. Check bucket/token, then click restore inject.':'Invalid device status history; check logger configuration.'}};
